prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and was stopped early.
Home wait_info changes (9 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though no effect was seen in the remaining six tests.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), and changing finish copy (2 tests) consistently showed no effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because fewer than two tests agree.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Live Desktop Pet Rendering Activity Hub: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout featuring real-time rendering step indicators and interactive progress visualizers. (why: Home wait median duration is 201s (mean 2336s). Prior tests show home wait information improvements consistently drive higher onboarding completion.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Companion Archetype Quiz Flow: Insert a short interactive quiz screen right after story scroll to help users determine their ideal companion path. (why: Choose path drops 20.6% of users with high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation when selecting a companion type.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls & Interaction Hub: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight view showcasing desktop shortcuts and pet visibility controls. (why: Multiple support tickets cited confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once setup is complete.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Desktop Generation Milestone Stream: Add real-time progress text milestones and a dynamic time estimate counter on the waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time during generation reaches 2336s. Home wait info updates have proven effective in past iterations.)
4: [home, notification] Background Generation System Tray Notification Prompt: Add an explicit system tray notification prompt on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Generation mean time exceeds 38 minutes (2336s). Users switch away or close the app thinking it stalled.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Full-Bleed Companion Journey Intro Layout: Transform the story screen into a full-bleed visual layout with high-impact hero graphics and a clear progress indicator. (why: 20.6% of users drop off at choose_path with high mean duration (514s). Stronger visual context speeds up decision making.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls Guidance Messaging: Revise headline and body copy on the final screen to give clear instructions on how to toggle, move, and talk to the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding, summoning, or controlling the pet on desktop.)

scores.note: Home redesign showed mild positive lift (+1.9%) in prior test; high development cost.
Adding new quiz screen/flow consistently hurts onboarding performance based on past lessons.
Finish step loses 29.1% and support mails confirm user confusion; previous redesign yielded +5.5% lift.
Home wait_info changes have strong win record (3 major wins) and past predictions underestimated their impact.
Addresses long wait time (2336s mean), but unproven test type requiring native release.
Choose_path has 20.6% drop-off; previous layout test showed slight positive gain (+1.3%).
Config-only change supported by user feedback, but finish copy changes consistently showed no positive effect.
